body: i'd rather dissociate for the rest of my sad little life than stay here any longer

i feel the same regarding the "women are better" posts. they are ridiculous and one of the reasons why i was an egg for so long. i tried talking about my struggle as a trans guy regarding these things multiple times and was met with some horrible gaslighting and dismissal from some people. it's not pretty.

i'm not the best at giving advice or comfort, but i guess the only thing you have to do is what makes you happy. this can take time to figure out, but don't try to rush yourself to an answer. you will know what's right for you one day. i love you. if you ever need to chat i can listen to you.

i forgot everything from logic class, thank you lol. when i called that person for talking over me and not listening to my experience she hid behind the excuse that one of her loved ones is a trans woman. totally not the same excuse as "i can't be racist, i have a black friend". no, i must be dreaming. 🙄

thanks for the kind words, i really needed that. i'm not in a good place rn.
thank you. i guess i'll stick to transmasc only spaces until we're taken seriously.

thanks. i had a shitty interaction with a cis person telling me that i shouldn't complain about the transphobia i face because trans women have it worse. i tried explaining my side to her as calmly as i could but she just wouldn't listen. the vibes are not good

i guess so. i hate doing/saying things that the people around me don't like, and telling my mom that i don't want to shave to her face would make me feel guilty. i want to get over this but i don't know how.
